aboutGame.title: What is PAPERHEAD?
paragraphs: PAPERHEAD is a fast-paced first-person boomer shooter set in a dark cardboard world. Players blast through hordes of paper and cardboard monsters with an arsenal of weapons and a magical pencil, chasing the mystery behind the bleeding paper universe.
Every zone folds and unfolds around you, hiding secrets, collectibles and alternate routes. Between brutal boss fights and hidden lore, PAPERHEAD rewards curiosity and fast reflexes in equal measure.

faq.title: PAPERHEAD FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about PAPERHEAD.

items.question: What is PAPERHEAD?
items.answer: PAPERHEAD is a fast-paced first-person boomer shooter set in a dark cardboard world. You fight paper and cardboard monsters with powerful weapons and a magical pencil while uncovering the mystery behind the bleeding paper universe.

items.question: Is PAPERHEAD available on Steam?
items.answer: Yes. PAPERHEAD is a PC game sold on Steam, and it supports cloud saves, achievements and a free demo you can try before you buy the full version.

items.question: How difficult is PAPERHEAD for new players?
items.answer: PAPERHEAD is unforgiving but fair. The beginner guide covers movement, weapon switching and resource management so you can survive your first few hours without wasting ammo.

items.question: Does PAPERHEAD have multiple endings?
items.answer: Yes. The PAPERHEAD story reacts to how you treat the world, and finishing a zone without taking any damage can trigger an alternate ending path.

items.question: How do I unlock every PAPERHEAD achievement?
items.answer: PAPERHEAD achievements span story milestones, exploration, combat mastery, collectibles, secrets and speedruns. Check the achievements guide for each unlock condition.
